chunks: Whatever was in it from Ibrāhīm ibn Mahziyār, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from al-Ḥimyarī, from Ibrāhīm ibn Mahziyār.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; one of the intermediaries in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ: Ibrāhīm ibn Mahziyār; the narrator to whom this chain leads.
key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: Al-Ḥimyarī; a narrator in the transmission chain.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a technical expression of hadith transmission.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ibrāhīm ibn Mahziyār in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Ibrāhīm ibn Mahziyār. It serves as a technical notice of transmission, identifying the intermediaries between the compiler and the named narrator.
